steps.name: Archive workspace paths
steps.description: Pack workspace paths into a tar.gz archive with a sha256 checksum — pair with buz/oss-upload or buz/s3-upload to publish it.
steps.description_zh: 将 workspace 中的路径打包为 tar.gz 归档并生成 sha256 校验和——配合 buz/oss-upload 或 buz/s3-upload 发布。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Archive workspace paths
steps.description: Two modes. pack (default, Runner workspace) — pack workspace paths into a tar.gz archive with a sha256 checksum; pair with buz/oss-upload or buz/scp-upload to publish it. extract (engine: ssh, target hosts) — unpack a tar.gz into an absolute directory on each target host; pair with buz/scp-upload for the delivery leg. Requires tar on the target hosts.
steps.description_zh: 两种模式。pack(默认，Runner 工作区)——将 workspace 路径打包为 tar.gz 并生成 sha256 校验和;extract(engine: ssh，目标主机)——在目标主机上将 tar.gz 解包到绝对目录。需要目标机装有 tar。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Git checkout
steps.description: Check out a Git repository into the workspace — the buz equivalent of actions/checkout. Checks out the triggering commit (BUZ_GIT_SHA) by default on webhook triggers; ref accepts branches, tags, and commit SHAs (detached); optional submodules.
steps.description_zh: 将 Git 仓库检出到 workspace——对标 actions/checkout。webhook 触发时默认检出触发提交（BUZ_GIT_SHA）；ref 支持分支、标签和 commit SHA（detached）；可选拉取 submodules。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Fetch config bundle into the workspace
steps.description: Download a configuration bundle (tar.gz) into the workspace and unpack it — typically a presigned object-storage URL (OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2). Pair with the `config.render` block on later steps (render-only mode) to render env files. Requires curl and tar on the Runner host.
steps.description_zh: 下载配置包（tar.gz）到工作区并解包——通常使用对象存储的预签名 URL（OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2 通用）。后续步骤配合 config.render（render-only 模式）渲染 env 文件。需要 Runner 主机装有 curl 和 tar。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Fetch config bundle into the workspace
steps.description: Download a configuration bundle (tar.gz) and unpack it from a presigned object-storage URL (OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2), with optional HTTP Basic or header-based authentication. Dual engine: shell unpacks into the Runner workspace; engine: ssh (set `host:`) unpacks into an absolute directory on each target host. Pair with the `config.render` block on later steps (render-only mode). Requires curl and tar where it runs.
steps.description_zh: 下载配置包（tar.gz）到工作区并解包——通常使用对象存储的预签名 URL（OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2 通用）。后续步骤配合 config.render（render-only 模式）渲染 env 文件。需要 Runner 主机装有 curl 和 tar。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: DingTalk group notification
steps.description: Send a text message to a DingTalk custom-bot group, with optional HMAC signing and @all.
steps.description_zh: 向钉钉群自定义机器人发送文本消息，支持加签（HmacSHA256）与 @全员。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Docker image build and push
steps.description: Build an OCI image from a workspace context and push it to a registry. The pipeline step must mount the host Docker socket (docker-out-of-docker).
steps.description_zh: 从 workspace 构建上下文构建 OCI 镜像并推送至镜像仓库。Pipeline step 需挂载宿主 Docker socket（docker-out-of-docker）。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Docker image build and push
steps.description: Build an OCI image from a build context inside the step directory and push it to a registry; the step's run: can follow up on the built images. Requires the docker-socket capability. Reuses the job Docker config without including credentials or the job .buz directory in the build context.
steps.description_zh: 从步骤目录内的构建上下文构建 OCI 镜像并推送至镜像仓库；步骤的 run: 可对构建出的镜像做后续处理。需要 docker-socket capability；复用 job Docker 凭据，但禁止将凭据目录或 job .buz 目录包含进构建上下文。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Docker Compose deployment
steps.description: Deploy a Docker Compose project on the target SSH host — optional image injection, pull, recreate, and status. Pair with buz/http-check for readiness.
steps.description_zh: 在目标 SSH 主机上部署 Docker Compose 项目——可选镜像注入、拉取、重建与状态输出；配合 buz/http-check 做就绪检查。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Docker registry login
steps.description: Log the Docker CLI into a registry for later steps (docker build/push, engine docker pulls). Credentials land in the job-scoped DOCKER_CONFIG dir and are removed when the job ends. Requires the Docker CLI on the Runner host.
steps.description_zh: 登录容器镜像仓库，供后续步骤使用（docker build/push、docker 引擎拉私有镜像）。凭证写入 job 级 DOCKER_CONFIG 目录，job 结束即清除。需要 Runner 主机装有 Docker CLI。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Docker registry login
steps.description: Log the Docker CLI into a registry for later steps (docker build/push, engine docker pulls). Credentials land in the job-scoped DOCKER_CONFIG dir and are removed when the job ends. Optional debug output shows a redacted command and exit status. Requires the Docker CLI on the Runner host.
steps.description_zh: 登录容器镜像仓库，供后续步骤使用（docker build/push、docker 引擎拉私有镜像）。凭证写入 job 级 DOCKER_CONFIG 目录，job 结束即清除。可选 debug 输出脱敏命令和退出码。需要 Runner 主机装有 Docker CLI。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Docker registry logout
steps.description: Best-effort `docker logout` on the Runner host. Requires the Docker CLI on the Runner host. Pair with buz/docker-login when runners are shared. Local job-scoped credentials are removed by the Runner when the job ends regardless; this step keeps the host-global mode (`docker_config_isolation = "shared"`) tidy. For logins on deploy target hosts, pair with buz/docker-logout-remote.
steps.description_zh: 在 Runner 主机上尽力执行的 docker logout，与 buz/docker-login 配对使用。需要 Runner 主机装有 Docker CLI。本机 job 级凭证由 Runner 在 job 结束时自动清理；shared 模式或共享 runner 场景建议显式登出。目标主机上的登录请配对 buz/docker-logout-remote。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Feishu group notification
steps.description: Send a text message to a Feishu custom-bot group; auto-appends the Buz job link when BUZ_* metadata is present.
steps.description_zh: 向飞书群自定义机器人发送文本消息，自动附带 Buz 任务链接，支持 @全员。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Git clone
steps.description: Clone a Git repository into a workspace subdirectory (branch or tag, optional shallow, optional token for private HTTPS repos).
steps.description_zh: 将 Git 仓库克隆到 workspace 子目录（支持分支/标签、浅克隆，可选 token 访问私有 HTTPS 仓库）。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Git clone
steps.description: Clone a Git repository into the `into` directory (default source) inside the workspace, without overwriting an existing path.
steps.description_zh: 将 Git 仓库克隆到 workspace 内的 into 目录（默认 source），禁止覆盖已有路径。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Helm upgrade
steps.description: Run `helm upgrade --install` on the Runner host against a Kubernetes cluster — chart from the workspace, cluster credential passed as a masked secret.
steps.description_zh: 在 Runner 宿主机上对 Kubernetes 集群执行 `helm upgrade --install`——chart 来自 workspace，集群凭证以掩码 secret 传入。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Network readiness check (HTTP / TCP / UDP)
steps.description: Poll a service until it is ready — HTTP status polling (curl), TCP port probe (nc -z), or best-effort UDP probe. Absorbs the old buz/http-check and buz/wait-for-tunnel use cases. Requires curl and nc (openbsd-netcat) on the Runner.
steps.description_zh: 轮询服务直至就绪——HTTP 状态码轮询（curl）、TCP 端口探测（nc -z）、尽力而为的 UDP 探测。整合原 buz/http-check 与 buz/wait-for-tunnel 的场景。需要 Runner 装有 curl 和 nc（openbsd-netcat）。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Network readiness check (HTTP / TCP / UDP)
steps.description: Poll a service until it is ready — HTTP status polling (curl), TCP port probe (nc -z), or best-effort UDP probe. Absorbs the old buz/http-check and buz/wait-for-tunnel use cases. Requires curl and nc (openbsd-netcat) on the Runner.
steps.description_zh: 轮询服务直至就绪——HTTP 状态码轮询（curl）、TCP 端口探测（nc -z）、尽力而为的 UDP 探测。整合原 buz/http-check 与 buz/wait-for-tunnel 的场景。需要 Runner 装有 curl 和 nc（openbsd-netcat）。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Kubernetes apply
steps.description: Apply a manifest from the workspace to a Kubernetes cluster using kubectl on the Runner host, with the cluster credential passed as a masked secret.
steps.description_zh: 使用 Runner 宿主机上的 kubectl，将 workspace 中的清单应用到 Kubernetes 集群——集群凭证以掩码 secret 传入。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Download file from Alibaba Cloud OSS
steps.description: Download one object from an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket with ossutil v2 — the download counterpart of buz/oss-upload. Dual engine: docker unpacks into the Runner workspace; engine: ssh (set `host:`) downloads directly on each target host (ossutil required there). AK/SK are masked inputs (digest-pinned image for the docker context).
steps.description_zh: 使用 ossutil v2 从阿里云 OSS 存储桶下载单个对象到 Buz 工作区——buz/oss-upload 的下载对称版。AK/SK 以 masked 输入传入 digest 锁定的 oss-tools 镜像。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Upload file to Alibaba Cloud OSS
steps.description: Upload one file from the Buz workspace to Alibaba Cloud OSS with ossutil v2.
steps.description_zh: 使用 ossutil v2 将 Buz 工作区中的单个文件上传到阿里云 OSS。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Upload file to Alibaba Cloud OSS
steps.description: Upload one file from the Buz workspace to Alibaba Cloud OSS with ossutil v2.
steps.description_zh: 使用 ossutil v2 将 Buz 工作区中的单个文件上传到阿里云 OSS。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Upload file to S3
steps.description: Upload one file from the Buz workspace to an S3 bucket using the official AWS CLI v2.
steps.description_zh: 使用 AWS CLI v2 将 Buz 工作区中的单个文件上传到 S3 存储桶。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Upload file to S3
steps.description: Upload one file from the Buz workspace to an S3 bucket using the official AWS CLI v2.
steps.description_zh: 使用 AWS CLI v2 将 Buz 工作区中的单个文件上传到 S3 存储桶。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Upload file to target host via scp
steps.description: Copy one file from the Buz workspace to a target host over SSH/SCP (engine: shell — runs on the Runner). Key-based auth only: the private key is a masked input written to a per-step temp file and removed afterwards. Prerequisites: ssh/scp on the Runner; the target's `authorized_keys` must trust the matching public key (config only — nothing is installed on the target).
steps.description_zh: 通过 SSH/SCP 将 Buz 工作区中的单个文件复制到目标主机(engine: shell,在 Runner 上执行)。仅支持密钥认证:私钥为 masked 输入,写入步骤级临时文件用后即删。前提:Runner 装有 ssh/scp;目标机 authorized_keys 信任对应公钥(仅配置,目标机不安装任何东西)。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Go build environment
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned Go toolchain (1.26 or 1.25) with an explicit GOROOT.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Go build environment
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Go toolchain (1.26 or 1.25) with an explicit GOROOT for the step's run: commands.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Go 工具链（1.26 或 1.25），显式设置 GOROOT。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Java build environment (Temurin JDK)
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned Temurin JDK (21, 25, or 17) with JAVA_HOME exported. Maven users can add -Dmaven.repo.local to share the local repository via the cache.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Java build environment (Temurin JDK)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Temurin JDK (21, 25, or 17) with JAVA_HOME exported for the step's run: commands. Maven users can add -Dmaven.repo.local to share the local repository via the cache.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Temurin JDK（21、25 或 17），导出 JAVA_HOME。Maven 用户可通过 cache 共享本地仓库（-Dmaven.repo.local）。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Lua runtime (5.4/5.3/LuaJIT)
steps.description: Run commands with a pinned Lua interpreter — lua 5.4, lua 5.3, or LuaJIT 2.1, all Debian-packaged.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Lua runtime (5.4/5.3/LuaJIT)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Lua interpreter for the step's run: commands — lua 5.4, lua 5.3, or LuaJIT 2.1, all Debian-packaged.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Lua 解释器——lua 5.4、lua 5.3 或 LuaJIT 2.1，均为 Debian 官方包。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Node.js build environment (npm)
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned Node.js toolchain (24 active LTS or 22 maintenance LTS) with npm and corepack.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Node.js build environment (npm)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Node.js toolchain (24 active LTS or 22 maintenance LTS) with npm and corepack for the step's run: commands.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Node.js 工具链（24 活跃 LTS 或 22 维护 LTS），内置 npm 与 corepack。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: PHP build environment (composer)
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned PHP toolchain (8.4 or 8.3) with Composer.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: PHP build environment (composer)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned PHP toolchain (8.4 or 8.3) with Composer for the step's run: commands.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 PHP 工具链（8.4 或 8.3），内置 Composer。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Python build environment (pip)
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned Python toolchain (3.14, 3.13, or 3.12) with pip.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Python build environment (pip)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Python toolchain (3.14, 3.13, or 3.12) with pip for the step's run: commands.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Python 工具链（3.14、3.13 或 3.12），内置 pip。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Ruby build environment (gem/bundler)
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned Ruby toolchain (3.4 or 3.3). 3.3 is EOL upstream and kept for existing applications.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Ruby build environment (gem/bundler)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Ruby toolchain (3.4 or 3.3) for the step's run: commands. 3.3 is EOL upstream and kept for existing applications.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Ruby 工具链（3.4 或 3.3）。3.3 上游已 EOL，仅为存量应用保留。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Rust build environment (cargo)
steps.description: Run commands inside a pinned Rust toolchain. The image ships stable (Rust 1.99 at image 1.0.0); other X.Y toolchains and nightly install on demand via rustup.
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Rust build environment (cargo)
steps.description: Prepare a pinned Rust toolchain (cargo/rustc) for the step's run: commands. The image ships stable (Rust 1.99 at image 1.0.0); other X.Y toolchains and nightly install on demand via rustup.
steps.description_zh: 为步骤的 run: 命令准备固定的 Rust 工具链（cargo/rustc）。镜像内置 stable（Rust 1.99，image 1.0.0）；其他 X.Y 工具链与 nightly 通过 rustup 按需安装。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Slack incoming-webhook notification
steps.description: Post a message to a Slack channel via an incoming webhook; auto-appends the Buz job link.
steps.description_zh: 通过 Slack incoming webhook 发送消息，自动附带 Buz 任务链接。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Wait for SSH host (reboot / rebuild)
steps.description: Block until an SSH server answers on the target host — wait out a reboot or cloud-init before the next deploy step. Runs from the runner host.
steps.description_zh: 等待目标主机 SSH 可登录（重启/重装后），再继续后续部署步骤。利用 Runner 出站网络，无需目标机暴露额外端口。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: Generic webhook notification
steps.description: POST a JSON message to any webhook endpoint — the engine-agnostic notification for targets without a dedicated plugin.
steps.description_zh: 向任意 webhook 端点 POST JSON 消息——没有专用插件的通知目标用它。自动附加 job 元数据。
steps.author: buz maintainers

steps.name: WeCom group notification
steps.description: Send a text message to a WeCom (WeChat Work) group bot; auto-appends the Buz job link.
steps.description_zh: 向企业微信群机器人发送文本消息，自动附带 Buz 任务链接，支持 @全员。
steps.author: buz maintainers
